summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py, with tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. Results: the new tests and test/test_path.py pass (40 passed); the whole test/test_extras directory passes (98 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing is committed and no existing file was changed. Deviations: (1) I added a guard that raises SHACLPathError for any non-Node input before any graph lookup, because None would act as a wildcard in graph queries; this guard may trigger warn_unreachable under mypy since the parameter is annotated Node. (2) mypy is not installed in the prepared venv, so type-ignore placement and 88-column line limits were checked by reading only.
